measurement.legacy_gpu_ms_scope: Legacy name for host terrain preparation, including CPU work; not device execution

measured_process_usage.clock_scope: Unix timestamps bracket the batch and CPU samples for observation alignment only; wall-clock adjustments may affect them. Latency uses the existing monotonic perf_counter interval. No per-request CPU attribution is implied.
measured_process_usage.scope: RUSAGE_SELF deltas for the whole process and all its threads around the measured batch, including executor creation/join and host driver work. Excludes startup, warmups, readiness wait and later snapshot/hash/NBT validation work. GPU device execution and other processes are not CPU time here. Context-switch/fault counts are platform-reported observations, not wait durations. Average scheduled cores is CPU seconds divided by elapsed batch seconds, not worker occupancy or an elapsed-time share.

memory_peak_scope.generation_peak_rss_bytes: Process lifetime through measured generation, including startup and warmups; excludes later snapshot processing and output validation
memory_peak_scope.note: High-water marks, not current RSS or isolated phase allocations; neither field proves sustained memory stability
memory_peak_scope.peak_rss_bytes: Process lifetime through output hashing, optional NBT comparison and optional specialization regeneration; retained legacy field

counter_storage.bytes_scope: Counter backing only; excludes allocator overhead and candidate/terrain tracking.
counter_storage.snapshot_scope: Shards are read sequentially. Totals are exact modulo u64 after updates join; a live snapshot is not a single instant across concurrent writers.

performance_diagnostics.note: Measured-interval deltas. Unique keys are first seen during this interval, excluding warmup keys. Recursive/concurrent durations overlap.
performance_diagnostics.scope: profile lifetime; concurrent and recursive durations overlap
performance_diagnostics.terrain_tile_scope: Measured-interval generation counts, including repeated tiles and all GPU guards; coordinates and side are chunks
